array.string: set -a; [ -f "$HOME/.config/opencode/.env.secrets" ] && source "$HOME/.config/opencode/.env.secrets"; set +a; launchctl setenv Z_AI_API_KEY "$Z_AI_API_KEY"; launchctl setenv FEISHU_APP_SECRET "$FEISHU_APP_SECRET"; echo "$(date '+%F %T') gui-keys injected (Z=${Z_AI_API_KEY:+ok}/F=${FEISHU_APP_SECRET:+ok})" >> "$HOME/Backups/opencode/gui-keys.log"
